company.name: Templarbit
company.shortDescription: Templarbit protects applications from malicious activity.
company.description: Templarbit is a startup for protecting applications from malicious activity known as “xss attacks.”

productsAndServices.description: A service that monitors the security posture of any vendor in real time to support third-party risk assessments.
productsAndServices.name: Next-Gen Third-Party Risk Assessments

productsAndServices.description: A monitoring service that tracks uptime, security configurations, subdomain discovery, certificate transparency, response times, SSL, DNS, and email settings for web applications.
productsAndServices.name: Comprehensive Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: A service that identifies look-alike and name-blending domains used to impersonate a company’s website or app and alerts users when new such domains appear.
productsAndServices.name: Domain Impersonation Detection

productsAndServices.description: A tool that assesses the security posture of web applications and websites by evaluating key security headers and settings, providing grades and recommendations.
productsAndServices.name: Security Configuration Checks

productsAndServices.description: APIs that provide access to Templarbit’s collected security data, enabling custom workflows, integrations, and product extensions.
productsAndServices.name: API Access

productsAndServices.description: A service that provides insights into the security posture and performance metrics of vendors critical to a business.
productsAndServices.name: Vendor Monitoring
